title: Moon Walk Effects
hook: What if you took a stroll on the Moon?
banner:
WHAT IF YOU WALK
ON THE MOON

beats.line: Your weight drops to one-sixth, so you bounce high like a rubber ball.
beats.idea: Character in a white suit leaping high, low gravity bounce, dust swirling.

beats.line: Blood shifts upward, puffing your face and making eyes glassy.
beats.idea: Close-up of character's face, cheeks swollen, eyes wide, fluid shift effect.

beats.line: Your inner ear loses its up-down cue, leaving you dizzy.
beats.idea: Character stumbling, cartoon swirl around head, vestibular confusion.

beats.line: Your heart rate drops slightly as low gravity eases circulation.
beats.idea: Heart icon with slower pulse, character's chest showing slower thump.

beats.line: Cosmic radiation reaches you on the Moon, suit shielding is limited.
beats.idea: Radiation symbols hitting the suit, character's outline glowing.

description: A quick visual guide to the physical effects of walking on the Moon.

facts.claim: Moon gravity is about one-sixth of Earth's gravity

end.line: Would you take a leap on the Moon?

topic: What happens if you walk on the moon?
